message.content: There is no mention of Adam Smith sending a specific message regarding the upcoming building maintenance schedule to Li Hua before the weather-related changes were made public. In one of the messages, Adam Smith informs Li Hua about a planned power outage from 2 PM to 3 PM on a certain day (message 1), which appears unrelated to the maintenance schedule. However, no prior notification about the maintenance schedule is documented in the given exchanges. Therefore, based on the available information, it cannot be conclusively determined whether Adam Smith sent a message about the maintenance schedule before the weather-related changes were announced.
